relations.subject: Brian Houghton Hodgson
relations.evidence: and the next two years at Richmond, Surrey under the tutelage of Daniel Delafosse.

relations.subject: Brian Houghton Hodgson
relations.evidence: He went to study at the East India Company College and showed an aptitude for languages... He graduated in December 1817 as a gold medallist.

relations.subject: Brian Houghton Hodgson
relations.evidence: An early influence was Thomas Malthus who was a family friend and a staff member at the college.

relations.subject: Brian Houghton Hodgson
relations.evidence: He collected Buddhist texts in Sanskrit and Pali and studied them with his friend Pandit Amritananda.

relations.subject: Brian Houghton Hodgson
relations.evidence: he was influenced by the works of William Jones, Friedrich Schlegel, Johann Blumenbach and Jame Prichard.
